notes: The recast possessive gives *had* to the possessive `לְ` and the subject pronoun *she* to its suffix (rule 43); the participle `יֹשֵׁב` keeps its own *abiding*, so it is not a candidate for the *have*.

`פְּתִיל הַנְּעֹרֶת` → *a string of tow*: the phrase's single determiner is the indefinite *a*, which belongs to `פְּתִיל` under rule 15, so the rectum's article is `unrepresented` rather than fronted (rule 29).
*inner chamber* heads on the class noun with the competing modifier reading named, as rule 31 requires; the Hebrew gloss *smelleth* was read and set aside (rule 38).
